title: DCFA: Dual-view Causal-inspired Attribution for Failure Reasoning in LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.04749v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have experienced rapid growth in recent years. Despite their promise, such systems remain fragile, frequently exhibiting reasoning and coordination errors that can lead to system-level failures. Failure attribution in such systems relies on tracing natural language interactions among agents to identify the decisive error, which refers to the earliest action whose correction can reverse system failure. There are two key challenges: 1) Shallow attribution: Existing methods often capture only minor deviations, such as incomplete retrievals or formatting errors, which verification mechanisms can correct, while missing the decisive cause of system failure. 2) Contextual degradation: As the length of the system traces increases, the model's reasoning ability rapidly deteriorates. To address these challenges, we propose DCFA, a training-free framework for failure attribution. DCFA integrates

translated_title: DCFA：面向基于大语言模型的多智能体系统故障推理的双视角因果启发归因方法
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统近年来发展迅速。尽管前景广阔，此类系统仍然十分脆弱，经常出现推理和协调错误，从而可能导致系统级故障。此类系统中的故障归因依赖于追踪智能体之间的自然语言交互，以识别决定性错误，即最早的、若加以修正即可逆转系统故障的动作。这里存在两个关键挑战：1）浅层归因：现有方法往往只能捕捉到微小的偏差，例如不完整的检索或格式错误，而这些偏差可以通过验证机制加以修正，却遗漏了系统故障的决定性原因。2）上下文退化：随着系统轨迹长度的增加，模型的推理能力会迅速下降。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了DCFA，一个无需训练的故障归因框架。DCFA整合了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DCFA，一种无需训练的双视角因果启发故障归因框架，通过追踪智能体间的自然语言交互，解决现有方法浅层归因和长轨迹下上下文退化的两大挑战，从而准确定位导致LLM多智能体系统故障的决定性错误。
en_tdlr: DCFA is a training-free, dual-view causal-inspired failure attribution framework that addresses shallow attribution and contextual degradation to pinpoint the decisive error behind failures in LLM-based multi-agent systems.
